name: Punctuation Geometry: Comma Frequency
description: Analyzes the statistical frequency, token spacing, and rigid syntactic placement of commas against human cognitive baselines.
mechanism: Text generated by Large Language Models adheres stringently and algorithmically to standardized grammatical parsing rules. Because they are mathematical optimizers, LLMs deploy commas with prescriptive, 'textbook-perfect' accuracy—methodically separating independent clauses, list items, and introductory adverbs without fail. In contrast, authentic human writers utilize punctuation not just for grammar, but for pacing. Humans frequently omit commas when rushing through an energetic thought, or hyper-deploy them to emulate a dramatic spoken pause or hesitation. This method analyzes not just the raw density of commas, but computes the highly predictable distance (in tokens) between them and their flawless alignment with dependency parse trees. An overly perfect, mathematically consistent, and perfectly paced comma distribution acts as a 'punctuation fingerprint', starkly revealing the machine's underlying, unyielding grammatical safety protocols.
useCase: Identifying AI generation through its absolute, unwavering, and mathematically flawless adherence to strict, formal punctuation rules, particularly in domains where humans write casually.
strengths:
• Extremely fast, lightweight heuristic mathematical filter that perfectly complements heavier semantic or embedding-based analysis methods.
• Virtually impossible for average users to bypass via simple prompt engineering ('write without commas' usually breaks the LLM's output entirely).
• Highly cross-lingual: robustly applicable to any language structure that heavily utilizes comma-based syntactic pacing (English, Spanish, French, etc.).
limitations:
• Professional human copy editors or writers heavily reliant on aggressive grammar-correction software (like Grammarly) will perfectly mimic this exact sterile signature, causing massive false positives.
• Inherently suffers from limited statistical efficacy on short texts (like tweets) where punctuation data points are too sparse to form a geometric pattern.
• Can be trivially bypassed post-generation by a simple, randomized script that deletes 10% of commas.
parameters:
Analysis: Token-distance Measurement & Syntactic Alignment
Metric: Inter-Punctuation Variance & Density Curve
Output: 0-100 Grammatical Sterility (Over-Perfection) Score
accuracy: Moderate — 65-75%. Highly specialized but extremely prone to false positives if the human author relies on grammar-correction software.

references.title: Manning, C.D. & Schütze, H. (1999). Foundations of Statistical Natural Language Processing. MIT Press.
Uchendu, A. et al. (2020). Authorship Attribution for Neural Text Generation. EMNLP.
